notes.detailedSummary: Retain an algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field of arbitrary cardinality, smooth integral projective original X of dimension n>=1, projective birational q:X->Y with Y integral normal projective, actual ample rational A and actual L=q*A. The proof replaces proposal130's use of defective general extended-valued closure with actual section descent plus ample compactness. It proves onto membership of the entire initially defined varying-class numerical cone, actual fixed-L regularization, finite-stage model projection with central multiplicities, bounded local compatibility, full mixed/floor/weighted limits, E1 and energy equality, raw mass L^n=A^n=vol(L), intrinsic targets and actual original-carrier solutions. notes.text:
This is a proof draft relative to the task's exact actual-ample G0, not independent certification of that grant or a solution of original P16.5.

Retain k algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero, arbitrary cardinality; X smooth integral projective, n>=1; q:X->Y projective birational with Y integral normal projective; A actual ample rational; and the actual isomorphism L=q*A. Use the literal one-net numerical PSH cone of all-point decreasing real FS functions in actual B_i with c1(B_i)->c1(L), rather than defining a pullback cone. Reference is the actual canonical metric0.

First, any such numerical function embeds in one sufficiently ample actual M: multiply its section formulas by generators of M-B_i on a tail. Generated canonical zero scalars preserve the original function exactly, also at poles. Thus ample all-point divisorial determination applies.

Write q as the blowup of a generically trivial ideal b, with effective exceptional E, and choose actual ample H on Y with H⊗b generated and q*H-E ample. These are the retained algebraic construction in the supplied BJ v4 Theorem4.32 proof. Normal proper birational descent gives q_*O_X=O_Y: regular upstairs functions have no codimension-one poles on the normal base, by proper valuative lifting and the normal-ring intersection characterization. Hence actual sections H0(X,mq*B)=H0(Y,mB). Let beta=log|b|, with q*beta=log||s_E|| and beta(v0)=0.

For fixed rational epsilon>0, a tail of the defining u_i embeds in actual q*(A+epsilon H)-epsilon E; multiply by s_epsilonE and descend sections. This gives a decreasing fixed-(A+epsilon H) FS net downstairs, whose actual ample endpoint phi_epsilon obeys q*phi_epsilon=u+epsilon q*beta everywhere. No infinite values are subtracted. Normalize (phi_epsilon-u(v0))/(1+eta) into the actual A cone using eta A-epsilon H ample. As eta,epsilon->0, its finite divisorial coordinates converge to those of u-u(v0) in the common function field. Ample compactness supplies an actual A-psh endpoint. Pullback and common-ample all-point determination give u=q*psi everywhere. Thus q*PSH(Y,A)=PSH(X,L) for the whole genuine numerical cone, with order and divisorial homeomorphism. This avoids the general BJ4.6 flattening lemma, whose abstract statement fails at common poles.

Fixed-L sections all descend, and ample regularization gives decreasing fixed-L continuous FS approximants. At finite rational metric stages, use actual nef model intersections on a common normal graph model. The coefficient is b_F (L_1...L_n.[F]), where b_F=ord_F(t) and v_F=b_F^-1 ord_F|k(X). Components mapping to smaller dimension have zero pulled n-fold degree; over a downstairs central component the degree-one birational projection is an isomorphism at its generic DVR. The fundamental central cycle and every b_F are retained. Therefore the actual upstairs products push to the actual downstairs products before taking limits. Compactified intersection projection gives finite energy pairing equality. BE regularization and continuous product compatibility handle real finite coefficients.

Choose Z where q is not an isomorphism, F=q^-1Z, using analytic support rather than valuation centers. Ample finite-energy mixed measures and targets give Z^an zero mass. One explicit proof constructs a normalized section potential a vanishing on Z, proves Cap{a<=-t}<=n/t by ample integration by parts, and applies the energy criterion J(c)<=1+∫_1^∞t^n Cap{c<=-t}dt to c=1-(1-a)^alpha, 0<alpha<1/(n+1). This genuine finite-energy pole test forces zero mass by G0 integrability.

Positive finite-stage products have fixed mass V=A^n. On compact X^an every arbitrary subnet has a weak cluster. Each cluster has the prescribed downstairs pushforward and therefore zero F mass. Off F,Z, q^an is a homeomorphism, so the cluster is unique. The whole net converges independently of fixed-L approximation. This characterizes limits of actual products; a Radon lift is not their definition.

Local compatibility also precedes the unbounded operator. For independently supplied bounded generated raw FS/contact nets with the same endpoint, one actual ample collar has v=h0+p, Q={v<=0}, inner P={v<=-epsilon}. Choose R,M so h'=Rv+M+1 is below every endpoint on P and above whole tails on an outer strip. Glue Phi=p+R^-1 max(w-h',0) on Q and p outside. The exact G0 contact bridge makes Phi actual ample psh. On the inner chart w=R Phi+R h0+M+1, so curvature/products are actual ample products multiplied by the correct powers of R. The two nets have the same explicit global endpoint and therefore the same local limit. Matched actual unit-log frame changes give identical finite products; compact tests pass this to limits. This includes charts meeting F and is restricted to the stated generated category, without an arbitrary local-current density assertion.

Define actual original energy by mixed products and reference0, then by floors u_k=max(u,-k). It equals E_A(psi), so the actual floor space E1(X,L) equals q*E1(Y,A). The genuine winning-set floor operator agrees with the finite-stage limit and has raw mass V=L^n=A^n=vol(L), the last identity following from actual section equality and ample Hilbert asymptotics. Mixed products and all relative floors agree. For decreasing finite-energy tests and products, choose a common upper constant C. Positive weighted measures (C-u_0i)mu_i have downstairs G0 integrable weighted limits and convergent masses. The same compact uniqueness argument gives upstairs weighted convergence; subtract Cmu_i, and treat test differences separately. No arbitrary-Borel-net monotone convergence is assumed.

An original positive Radon target has mass V and finite intrinsic D_L(mu)=sup_{u∈E1}(E_L(u)-∫u dmu). Whole-cone and energy equality give D_L(mu)=D_A(q_*mu). Thus zero F mass follows from the intrinsic condition. G0 attains the downstairs objective and equation; its actual pullback attains the original objective and solves the already constructed operator by unique zero-F lifting. Comparison and positive-mass domination transfer via actual pulled strict sets and order. Equal measures imply actual all-point potentials differ by one constant.

For any original continuous f, fiber minimum a is lsc and maximum b usc. Off Z they agree. Choose clipped continuous minorants g<=a and majorants r>=b. Pulled obstacles bound the original envelope-energy difference quotient; for negative t both obstacle ordering and division reverse signs. Radon inner regularity gives compact K off Z with small complement. Continuous monotone approximants converge uniformly on K by the compact-Dini open-cover argument for arbitrary nets; the complement error is bounded by 2||f|| times its mass. Squeezing gives both outer derivatives ∫f MA_L(u). This handles directions that do not descend on exceptional fibers.

The proof is Sections1--4 of P16.5-argument.md and standalone P16.5-paper.tex; actual PDF is build/P16.5-paper.pdf. Frozen complete proposals, G0, primary units and precise current/historical coordinates are preserved under evidence/ and source-application-ledger.json. Run python3 rerun.py. Both final pdfLaTeX passes returned0. Compilation and hashes establish no mathematical correctness. This scoped semiample theorem leaves the unchanged full original problem partial.

notes.text:
Retain k algebraically closed trivially valued of characteristic zero and arbitrary cardinality. Let X=P1×P1, Y=P1, q=p1, r=p2, actual L=q*O(1), actual H=r*O(1), and references0. Here L^2=0, L.H=1, and h0(X,mL)=m+1, so top volume is0.

The exact G0 all-point fiber theorem applies because q is projective with geometrically connected fibers and O(1) is actual ample on the integral projective base. Every genuine numerical L-potential is constant on each analytic q-fiber, including -infinity. Pull its one defining varying-class FS net along the actual section s0 with second coordinate0. Sections restricting to zero are omitted. The pulled endpoint is generically finite because s0(v0) and the generic trivial point of X lie in the same analytic fiber. No identically infinite stage is possible. Thus s0*u genuinely belongs to PSH(Y,O(1)); fiber constancy gives all-point equality u=q*(s0*u). Conversely actual ample section pullback is genuine. This identifies the entire initially defined numerical cone, not a cone defined as pullbacks. Floors commute.

At finite actual metric stages define M(u)=T_(L,u) wedge T_(H,0). Multiply a base metric test configuration by the second P1. Each central E×P1 retains b_E=ord_E(t); its mixed intersection is the base metric degree times deg O(1)=1. The normalized component valuation extends the base by the Gauss polynomial rule |sum a_jw^j|=max_j|a_j|. Hence the actual model product gives M(q*psi)=sigma_*MA_A(psi), A=O(1), where sigma is the second-factor Gauss section over H(y). Its polynomial maximum formula is continuous, including projective overlaps; its graph is compact closed. Thus this is an actual product computation, not a manufactured inverse measure. Ample decreasing regularization, the bounded local compatibility argument of n1, and continuous sigma give independent mixed limits, reference floors and weighted convergence for psi∈E1(A).

The named lower-degree energy relative to the extra datum (H,0) is E_L,H(u)=1/2∫u[M(u)+M(0)]. Actual finite intersection projection, bounded weighted limits and then floors give E_L,H(q*psi)=E_A(psi), with entire intrinsic lower-degree floor space q*E1(A). Constants shift this energy by c. It is not probability normalization of L^2=0.

Let x0=s0(v0). The original measure mu=delta_x0 has correct mixed mass1. Every genuine test u=q*psi integrates to psi(v0)=sup psi. Raw ample energy is <=sup psi, with equality for constants, so D_L,H(mu)=sup(E_L,H(u)-∫u dmu)=0. Every such test is finite at x0. Nevertheless x0 is outside the Gauss graph: its seminorm kills w, whereas Gauss seminorms give |w|=1. Every actual output is supported on that graph, so mu is not M(u). In particular M(0)=delta_generic-trivial-X and delta_x0 differ as original Radon measures while agreeing on all genuine tests, pushforward and dual energy. An added auxiliary-ample polar/energy condition is not already present in this intrinsic mixed condition.

Set f0(w)=max(0,min(1,-log|w|)), extended1 at0 and0 at infinity, and f=r*f0. It is continuous because it is constant near both endpoints. Every analytic q-fiber has min f=0 and max f=1, attained by the actual infinity and zero sections over its completed residue field. A genuine competitor below tf is fiber constant. For t>0 it is <=0 everywhere, attained by0; for t<0 it is <=t, attained by the constant t. Therefore P_L(tf)=0 for t>=0 and t for t<0; E_L,H(P_L(tf))=min(0,t). Its right derivative is0, left derivative1. The actual measure M(0) integrates f to0, agreeing only with the positive sign. This is the continuous-obstacle outer energy itself.

Thus the recipe consisting of the whole L-cone, this named mixed operator, mass1, finite intrinsic dual energy, and both original continuous outer signs is false. The exact mixed image is instead the Gauss lift of ample finite-energy measures on Y. A justified alternate theory may retain carrier/fiber data, restrict exact targets or change variation directions; no universal impossibility is inferred.

notes.detailedSummary: The finite-continuous compact flattening argument proves PSH(L)=intersection_epsilon PSH(L+epsilon H) without the common-pole defect. It yields genuine nef membership, compactness, decreasing closure and usc envelopes. Bounded products are actual signed tensor-difference products of ample metrics, with positivity proved through L+epsilon H. Actual energy floors define the entire original function space E1_L. The estimate ∫(-u_k)MA(u_k)<= (n+1)(-E_L(u)) gives mass loss O(1/k), full raw L^n mass, self-integrability and a uniform total-variation floor error. Bounded signed convergence then proves arbitrary decreasing E1 weak continuity; locality plus full mass gives comparison. This does not prove full mixed/weighted E1 theory or a general existence/uniqueness theorem. Numerically trivial actual bundles have a constants-only zero-volume equation; nonbig nonzero classes require more data. All artifacts and twice-compiled paper are retained, with status PARTIAL.
notes.text:
Canonical status is PARTIAL and candidate=false for the exact unchanged original P16.5. The new claim below extends the genuine top operator beyond the scoped semiample equation of n1, and the limitation from n2 is retained. It is a proof draft, not execution-certified mathematics.

Retain the field/original-X hypotheses of n1 and any actual nef rational L, with no semiampleness, finite generation, countability, toric, skeletal or support restriction. For actual ample H, the entire literal varying-class cone satisfies PSH(X,L)=intersection_{epsilon∈Q>0}PSH(X,L+epsilon H). Forward inclusion embeds a defining FS net in each fixed ample bundle by generators of ample differences. Conversely, for u in every approaching ample cone, take G0 finite continuous fixed-(L+epsilon H) approximants f_epsilon,j↓u. Shift them by positive delta. Order triples by decreasing epsilon,delta and scalar. Given two old shifted functions, their minimum b is finite continuous; choose smaller epsilon3 and delta3 than both old deltas. Then u+delta3<b everywhere. The directed increasing open sets {f_epsilon3,j+delta3<b} cover compact X^an, so one later index covers it. This yields one decreasing FS net with the required class limit and endpoint, also at poles. It uses finite old majorants, so avoids the false general extended-valued flattening lemma.

Actual ample zero-weight generating systems give zero in this cone. All normalized potentials are <=0, so canonical reference0 is minimal. The intersection characterization proves decreasing closure and usc supremum membership. Normalized compactness follows by intersecting closed compact normalized ample-cone images inside the fixed normalized L+H cone. Continuous-obstacle envelopes belong to the cone and are decreasing limits of the approaching ample envelopes. Their continuity or orthogonality is not asserted.

For bounded genuine u_i on actual nef L_i, choose actual ample H_i and M_i=L_i+H_i. The actual tensor metric L_i,u_i is the difference of M_i,u_i and H_i,0. Expand its mixed products as the finite signed sum wedge_i(T_(M_i,u_i)-T_(H_i,0)). All entries are genuine ample finite-energy endpoints. Continuous stages are actual BE dpsh metric products on the original L_i, even though these signed stages need not be positive. G0 signed decreasing continuity and the actual local collar of n1 identify their bounded endpoint products, independent of frames and auxiliary decomposition. Independently supplied local generated weights are compared after adding the fixed raw H_i weight, then subtracting its curvature. For rational epsilon>0 the actual ample product on L_i+epsilon H_i is the same polynomial with coefficient -(1-epsilon) on the fixed H_i entries. Its positive weak limit is the bounded L_i product. Its raw mass is (L_1...L_n). Thus products are actual original metric operations before positivity and limits, not arbitrary Radon inverses.

Define bounded reference-zero E_L(u)=1/(n+1) sum_{j=0}^n ∫u T_(L,u)^j T_(L,0)^(n-j), using these independently constructed positive measures. Actual ample polynomial perturbations prove monotonicity, concavity, E_L(0)=0 and translation slope V=L^n. Define E_L(u)=lim_k E_L(max(u,-k)) and the actual E1_L={u∈PSH(L):E_L(u)>-infinity}. Decreasing energy continuity holds for arbitrary generically finite endpoints: at fixed k, floor products and their bounded weighted energies converge by G0 signed bounded convergence; E_L(u_i)>=E_L(u) and E_L(u_i)<=E_L(max(u_i,-k)); pass the original net, then k->infinity. This also gives concavity and bounded-reference floor compatibility. The space consists of actual original functions.

For u<=0, put u_k=max(u,-k), mu_k=MA_L(u_k). Borel bounded strict-winning locality makes 1_{u>-k}mu_k increase. Their mass-bounded limit is Radon by compact inner approximation and finite-mass complements; it defines the genuine reference nonpluripolar original operator. Different bounded references compare on common winning sets. For u∈E1_L, C=-E_L(u)<infinity, positivity in the energy sum proves
∫(-u_k)dmu_k <=(n+1)C and mu_k{u<=-k}<=(n+1)C/k.
Hence the nonpluripolar limit has full raw mass L^n, gives u's poles zero mass and satisfies ∫(-u)MA_L(u)<=(n+1)C. The equality with algebraic volume outside n1's semiample domain is not used to discharge further analytic gates here.

The endpoint measure and mu_k agree on {u>-k} and both have full mass, so their total-variation distance is at most 2(n+1)C/k. For a decreasing E1 net with E1 endpoint, choose a common upper scalar bound on a tail and normalize all by it. Monotonicity uniformly bounds negative energy, so this floor error is uniform on that tail. For fixed k the bounded products converge. First choose k, then the original net index. This proves genuine arbitrary decreasing-net weak continuity of the top operator.

Strict-winning locality passes to the nonpluripolar limit. For w=max(u,v), full mass gives MA(v){u<v}<=MA(u){u<=v}. Apply to v-delta and let delta↓0 through a sequence; the left sets exhaust {u<v} and right sets lie inside it. This proves genuine finite-energy comparison. Comparison alone is not domination or uniqueness.

For L numerically trivial, normalized defining FS functions embed after scaling in epsilon times an actual ample cone; compact divisorial evaluation lower bounds force every endpoint to be constant everywhere by ample determination. Constants genuinely arise from L+epsilon A generating sections. The actual canonical metric is the tensor quotient of ample canonical A+L and A; genuine signed products cancel to0. Its energy is0, sole positive mass-zero target is0, solutions are actual constants and are unique modulo constants, with zero outer derivatives. Cleared powers have h0=0 or1 because an effective numerically trivial zero divisor must be empty, so volume is0. For general nef L with L^n=0, all bounded positive top products and all floor energies/operators are zero, but the genuine cone can be nonconstant; n2 shows why neither top normalization nor its particular mixed recipe restores the full requested theory.

Concrete unproved statements: (i) on the entire intrinsic nef big floor space, full mixed integrable weighted convergence, weak energy usc/coercivity and target-integral continuity, two-sided outer differentiation, exact intrinsic targets, actual attainment, domination and uniqueness; (ii) on every big nonnef actual rational bundle, genuine intrinsic minimal/model reference membership, envelopes/compactness, independent original products of full volume mass, full relative energy/weighted/variational theory and equation; (iii) for general nonbig nonzero numerical pseudoeffective data, a genuinely retained additional datum and proved exact original target image/uniqueness relation. The signed ample space may be strictly smaller than intrinsic nonample E1, as supplied BJ v4 Remark7.16 explicitly warns. No unproved inclusion, nefness or semiampleness restriction is silently promoted to the full big domain.
